items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: I had it once a month, every first Sunday of the month we would do a spectacular in the show room and bring in a big concert with Duke Ellington... The first one I had was Duke Ellington

ctx.x: I never heard Jimmy Blanton, never heard his music until Joe Klute, this friend up the street, came down and brought these Jimmy Blanton records.
Were they the ones with Duke...
That's right. And he had every little thing that Jimmy did on this record, he had it down.
